description: This file defines the UploadAttendance class and functions for managing attendance data import/export in an ERP system, including CSV handling, permission checks, and data retrieval.

classes.name: UploadAttendance
classes.description: A Document class representing attendance upload records.

methods.name: get_template
methods.description: Generates a CSV template for attendance data with headers and status options.

methods.name: add_header
methods.description: Adds header rows to the CSV writer with instructions and status options.

methods.name: add_data
methods.description: Fetches attendance data and writes it to the CSV writer.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves attendance data for specified date range and employees, including holiday considerations.

methods.name: get_holidays_for_employees
methods.description: Retrieves holiday dates for a list of employees within a date range.

methods.name: writedata
methods.description: Writes data rows to the CSV writer.

methods.name: get_dates
methods.description: Generates a list of dates between from_date and to_date.

methods.name: get_active_employees
methods.description: Fetches all active employees from the database.

methods.name: get_existing_attendance_records
methods.description: Retrieves existing attendance records within a date range.

methods.name: get_naming_series
methods.description: Retrieves the default naming series for attendance records.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles CSV upload for attendance data and enqueues import task.

methods.name: import_attendances
methods.description: Processes CSV rows to import attendance records, handling errors and real-time updates.

methods.name: remove_holidays
methods.description: Filters out holiday rows from CSV data during import.
